title: Skin smooth @1
note: Gentle denoise and reduced texture inside an explicit skin mask. Inspect eyes, lips, hair and edges. Uses a hand-drawn skin demonstration mask, not AI segmentation. Skin example only covers arms, not a complete skin selection.

title: Subject Pop
note: Lift exposure, clarity and vibrance inside an explicit subject mask. Inspect selection edges. Uses a hand-drawn subject region; inspect edges.

title: B&W Classic
note: Neutral monochrome with moderate contrast and preserved highlights. Use strength 1 for full black and white.

title: B&W High Contrast
note: Deep blacks and a stronger contrast curve for graphic monochrome. Use strength 1 for full black and white.

title: B&W Matte
note: Soft monochrome with lifted blacks and compressed highlights. Use strength 1 for full black and white.

title: Teal & Orange
note: Channel curves cool shadows toward teal and warm highlights toward orange. This is tonal grading, not skin detection.

title: Cinematic
note: Restrained saturation, soft blacks, cool shadows and warm highlights. Keeps your original framing.

title: Wedding Clean
note: Neutral whites, gentle contrast and restrained color. Review white clothing and skin tones.

title: Wedding Airy
note: Brighter midtones, soft shadows and delicate highlights. Set exposure for each image first.

title: Golden Romance
note: Warm highlights, softened greens and gentle contrast for outdoor portraits.

title: Editorial Portrait
note: Clean color, deeper blacks and defined midtones without skin smoothing.

title: Soft Pastel
note: Soft contrast and subdued colors without an added pink cast or skin smoothing.

title: Indoor Celebration
note: Lift shadows and control bright highlights. Correct mixed-light white balance separately.

title: Family Natural
note: Balanced contrast and gentle vibrance with minimal stylization. Keeps skin texture.

title: Autumn Warmth
note: Warm earth tones and restrained greens. Review orange clothing and skin tones.

title: Landscape Crisp
note: Moderate dehaze and texture with richer blues and greens. Inspect edges for halos.

title: Woodland Soft
note: Soft highlights, muted greens and subtle warmth for forest scenes.

title: Night Sky Natural
note: Restrained tonal contrast and color. No denoise or sharpening; inspect stars at full resolution.

title: Milky Way Definition
note: Gentle contrast and dehaze inside an explicit sky mask. No denoise or sharpening; inspect stars and sky boundaries. Uses a hand-drawn dark background region, not a sky/star selection. This concert is not an astrophotography quality test.

title: Dark & Moody
